parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.leads_site (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  nome TEXT NOT NULL,
  telefone TEXT NOT NULL,
  email TEXT,
  servico TEXT DEFAULT 'outro',
  mensagem TEXT,
  origem JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  consentimento JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  raw_payload JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'novo',
  whatsapp_cliente_enviado BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  whatsapp_vendedor_enviado BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  erro_envio TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_leads_site_telefone ON public.leads_site (telefone);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_leads_site_email ON public.leads_site (email);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_leads_site_created_at ON public.leads_site (created_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_leads_site_status ON public.leads_site (status);

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.leads_site (
  nome,
  telefone,
  email,
  servico,
  mensagem,
  origem,
  consentimento,
  metadata,
  raw_payload,
  status
)
VALUES (
  $1,
  $2,
  $3,
  $4,
  $5,
  $6::jsonb,
  $7::jsonb,
  $8::jsonb,
  $9::jsonb,
  'recebido'
)
RETURNING
  id::text AS lead_id,
  created_at AS lead_created_at,
  nome,
  telefone,
  email,
  servico,
  mensagem,
  origem,
  consentimento,
  metadata,
  raw_payload,
  status;

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.leads_site
SET
  status = 'whatsapp_enviado',
  whatsapp_cliente_enviado = true,
  whatsapp_vendedor_enviado = true,
  erro_envio = NULL,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::bigint
RETURNING id::text AS lead_id, status, updated_at;

UPDATE public.leads_site
SET
  status = 'erro_envio',
  whatsapp_cliente_enviado = $2,
  whatsapp_vendedor_enviado = $3,
  erro_envio = $4,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::bigint
RETURNING id::text AS lead_id, status, erro_envio, updated_at;
